problem_statement: The MQTT-SN client library must support pre-defined topics. Before subscribing, the client should be able to register a topic's name together with a numeric topic identifier so that the gateway and client already know the mapping without a REGISTER exchange. Registering the same topic (by name or by identifier) twice must be rejected. When the client subscribes to a topic that has already been predefined, the SUBSCRIBE message must be sent using the numeric topic identifier rather than the topic name, and publishing to that topic must likewise use the predefined identifier without triggering a REGISTER. Receiving a PUBLISH on a predefined topic must still be delivered to the application with the correct payload.
